description: Na₂LiScF₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent LiF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent ScF₆ octahedra. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.84 Å. Li is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form LiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-F bond lengths are 2.01 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form ScF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent NaF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-F bond lengths are 2.01 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Na, one Li, and one Sc atom.
